title: Re: Vanguard Cash Plus Account
author: retiringwhen
content:
Bizarrely I am seeing excellent detail (same as my credit union's register) for two payments made yesterday that are in pending status, but no detail for everything earlier. The detail is visible on the dashboard under the order status display, and in the transaction list in the My Cash Plus Overview. All the detail is visible on the Transaction History page for all history.

I wonder if they are in some sort of transition on reporting details.

PS: I use Cash Plus as a staging area for retirement spending cash. I do distributions every 4-8 weeks (needs depending) to Cash Plus, then transfer cash to my credit union checking for most bill payments and pay off credit card bills from Cash Plus. This works great, has an easy workflow (99% of our retirement money is at Vanguard), and optimizes near term cash about as effectively as possible.

I keep cash that will be around a while in the retirement accounts in VUSXX,T-bills, etc., and get good interest in the Cash Plus for a short holding period. Most money only sits there a few weeks.

BTW, the detail question really does not bother me as I use Quicken to reconcile all transactions and the Cash Plus integration, while a bit clunky is reliable and correct. I have not had a problem in probably 2 years. I hardly ever look at Vanguard.com for Cash Plus details.
